newsitem.title: UK: BZW hires more yen fixed income staff.
newsitem.headline: BZW hires more yen fixed income staff.

text.p: BZW, the investment banking arm of Barclays Group, said on Thursday it had hired three people to join its yen fixed income operations.
Keith Jenkins, 36, has joined as a director and the head of yen trading in London, BZW said in a statement. He was previously head of yen trading in London at Morgan Stanley.

In Tokyo, Eishi Suzuki, 40, has joined as a director responsible for the corporate bond sales group and Akira Daimon, 34, has become an assistant director in charge of non-government yen bonds trading in Tokyo, BZW said.
Suzuki was previously with Morgan Stanley and Daimon joined from Sumitomo Bank, BZW said.
"As part of a strategy to build its global markets business, BZW recruited Patrick Lin as managing director in charge of the firm's overall fixed-income team in Tokyo," BZW said.
"Since joining in August, he has brought together a team of more than ten professional and today announces further hires," it said.
Last week Barclays Plc announced a 31 billion yen capital injection into BZW Securities (Japan) Ltd to expand the scope of its trading operations, the statement said.
